answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 51 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. What carries the violet here is verification, the ripple of cost is what stops the farm, and the comet of the record keeps every claim checkable.
